assumptions.choice: No entries are permitted on the supplied AAPL feed.
assumptions.reason: The specification restricts activity to major Forex pairs or the S&P 500/Dow Jones, while the fixed harness provides AAPL.

assumptions.choice: The trailing, incomplete opposite-regime rule is not implemented.
assumptions.reason: Its condition and required action are cut off in the supplied specification.

assumptions.choice: ATR(14) over the previous 50 periods is interpreted as the ATR(14) value 50 bars ago.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define an aggregation over those periods.

assumptions.choice: A 20-period price standard deviation is instantiated but does not drive a regime decision.
assumptions.reason: It is required as an indicator but no condition specifies how to use it.

assumptions.choice: No sizing order is submitted because entries are disallowed by the asset-universe rule.
assumptions.reason: The required 1%-of-total-capital sizing cannot apply without an eligible entry.
